body:
### Description

The following code fails on multi-process GPU jobs. In the example below, there are 4 processes, each with 1 GPU. I'm not sure it's a bug or a deliberate error in JAX, but I'll appreciate your help.

```python
import jax
jax.distributed.initialize()

import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax.sharding import NamedSharding, PartitionSpec as P, AxisType

mesh = jax.make_mesh((jax.device_count(),), ("x",), (AxisType.Auto,))
in_sharding = NamedSharding(mesh, P("x", None))
out_sharding = NamedSharding(mesh, P(None, "x"))

A = jnp.zeros((64, 64))
A = jax.device_put(A, in_sharding)
jax.block_until_ready(A)

@jax.jit
def fn(A):
    A = jax.lax.with_sharding_constraint(A, out_sharding)
    return A

out = fn(A)
jax.block_until_ready(out)
```

The error is
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/resnick/home/aochen/test/sharding/test_20260420_124314.py", line 25, in <module>
    jax.block_until_ready(out)
  File "/resnick/home/aochen/quantax_env/lib/python3.11/site-packages/jax/_src/api.py", line 2581, in block_until_ready
    try_to_block(arrays[0])
  File "/resnick/home/aochen/quantax_env/lib/python3.11/site-packages/jax/_src/api.py", line 2564, in try_to_block
    return x.block_until_ready()
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
jax.errors.JaxRuntimeError: INTERNAL: NCCL operation ncclAlltoAll( send_contiguous->opaque(), recv_contiguous->opaque(), ToNcclCount(dtype, count), nccl_dtype, comm_, AsCudaStream(stream)) failed: unhandled system error (run with NCCL_DEBUG=INFO for details). Last NCCL warning(error) log entry (may be unrelated) ''.
W0420 12:43:36.644361  582261 pjrt_client.cc:1604] WatchTasksAsync failed for task 0: UNAVAILABLE: Cancelling all calls
Additional GRPC error information from remote target coordination_service while calling /xla.coordination.CoordinationService/WatchTasks:
:UNKNOWN:Error received from peer  {grpc_status:14, grpc_message:"Cancelling all calls"}
```

I also tried a slightly different function
```python
@jax.jit(out_shardings=out_sharding)
def fn(A):
    return A
```
which gives the same error.

The error doesn't appear on
- `jax <= v0.9.1`
- single-process jobs
